question.text: As a result of Direct Payout, securities are credited to clients' demat accounts on:

answer.text: The same settlement day (T+1), instead of one working day from receipt of pay-out
The next working day after settlement

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Direct Payout, securities are credited to client demat accounts on the same settlement day (T+1), instead of the earlier one working day from receipt of pay-out. The Trap: The earlier route credited the broker pool account first and only later moved securities to clients; Direct Payout shortens that to the same settlement day. Note: The change is from "one working day from receipt of pay-out" to "same settlement day (T+1)" for credit to client demat accounts.
